name: Free-path sampling
aliases: Single Scattering Volume Path Tracing with Transmittance Sampling
definition: A method that avoids both distance and spherical integrations by letting the light ray randomly bounce off in the middle of participating media before hitting a surface.
summary: Free-path sampling determines the distance a ray travels in a homogeneous medium before interacting by directly sampling the interaction distance from the extinction coefficient, avoiding majorant bound iterations.
